commons.title: SHIKA-T CHALIE SANGWALI.jpg
commons.description:
Prince CHALIE Sangwali AKA (SHIKA-T) is a prince of the Mayeyi tribe in the Zambezi region of Namibia he is a direct descendent of the Chief (SHIKATI SHUFU) of the Mayeyi people. Shika-T Chalie has other prince's related to him. Prince Munakana, Prince Larry Mwikwanda, Prince Sandy Sangwali all are legible for selection to the throne of the Mayeyi Chieftainship.
SHIKA-T is well known for is love for his people, kind hearted, soft spoken, fearless leadership, very straightforward and eager to defend and protect the interest and development of his people.

SHIKA-T was raised in a mixed society he poses both modern and traditional qualities, he is a respectable individual amongst his peers. He fluent in 11 Namibian Languages. He devotes most of his time to the interest and uplift-ment of his tribes man.
commons.editorial_reason: Although the caption identifies a Mayeyi prince, the image is a modern portrait with ordinary clothing and no clearly visible traditional cultural practice or object.
